findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards recorded logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver, so any log calls made through it are recorded on a throwaway object. Since LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now calls m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), tests that inject a *log.TestLogger and then assert on InfoLogs.Calls/Message/Ctx will always observe zero calls, silently losing coverage of the logging middleware (and existing assertions would fail). FromContext (and New) should return the same instance so recorded logs are observable.

findings.title: Logger interface extended with FromContext (breaking for implementers)
findings.body: Adding FromContext(context.Context) Logger to the exported plugins/log.Logger interface breaks any existing implementation of that interface outside this package (e.g. in enterprise or test helpers), which will no longer compile. Worth confirming all implementers are updated in this PR or that the interface is internal.

findings.title: Stream endpoints get no contextual logging attributes
findings.body: SubscribeStream, PublishStream and RunStream pass the context through without calling instrumentContext, so logs emitted during stream handling (and by LoggerMiddleware for these endpoints) carry no pluginId/endpoint/dsUID attributes. Since the contextual logger is now the only source of these fields (they were removed from LoggerMiddleware's log params), this leaves stream requests unidentifiable in logs.

findings.title: Log fields now depend on a separate middleware being installed
findings.body: pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID and traceID were removed from LoggerMiddleware's logParams and now come only from the contextual logger installed by ContextualLoggerMiddleware. Anyone constructing middlewares without NewContextualLoggerMiddleware (e.g. other callers/tests building their own stack) will emit 'Plugin Request Completed' lines with no plugin identification at all, a silent regression in log usefulness. Consider keeping the essential fields here or documenting the hard ordering dependency.
